component: Account Hub manual OAuth hostname phases

quotes.text: "The auth method should stay set as OAuth2"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original hostname gate hides unsupported OAuth and, if it was selected, writes Normal Password into the matching form control and config-side auth value. Its new tests assert that reset for IMAP/POP3 and SMTP. Accepted source later retains the OAuth choice, shows an unsupported-host banner and rejects validate while that combination remains unsupported; its tests assert the retained choice and warning. Keep these source/test phases distinct when reusing the direct-input hostname lookup contract. Neither option visibility nor a passing static lookup establishes an OAuth authentication result.
title: The first Account Hub OAuth hostname gate resets the choice, while the later phase warns
